name: Heather's Haunted House Party
source:
Left alone for the week, the most popular girl in school wants to throw the scariest haunted house party, but she’s terrified of everything.

[From [url=https://alicequinnart.itch.io/heathers-haunted-house-party]Itch.io[/url]]

学校里最受欢迎的女孩独自一人呆了一周，想要举办最恐怖的鬼屋派对，但她对一切都感到害怕。
